projects.title: Static Checks for Programming Exercises
bullets: Wrote Python checks for selected code patterns in small programming exercises during a supervised undergraduate independent study.
Parsed small public numeric-computation example programs using abstract syntax trees as part of the static-checking work.

projects.title: Path Search on Public Route Graphs
bullets: Constructed graphs from public walking-route tables using Python and NetworkX as an assigned contribution to a supervised undergraduate course project.
Implemented shortest-path queries and tested disconnected graph cases for path search on public walking-route networks.
